scope: native time-aware Stage Zone isolation, unstaged notes and authored Zone guides for the prepared v2 preview
invariants: One presentation window per Layout occurrence covers [0, showEndMs) half-open, in start order, with that occurrence's identity.
The occurrence-at-zero projection published by preparation is unchanged; preparation and preview share one projection owner.
Presentation is presentation only: artifact, recipe, replay runtime, seek/checkpoint/prewarm/capture paths, transport state and published digest are untouched by solo, guides or a Layout switch.
A positive incoming Layout transfer keeps its source Layout's pixels owned while blending, so no routed output is hidden.
Elapsed playback time wraps at Show End exactly like the transport position the frame reports.
Zone-complete coverage without solo paints the compiler frame itself; only pixels the active Layout leaves unstaged are dimmed.
Derivation never mutates the captured record and allocates no identity.
partitions: installation physical Layouts with swapped/narrowed ranges, portable-2d logical split reprojection, unmapped generic strips
occurrence boundary: before, exactly at, one step after, fractional frame times, Show End wrap and second loop
timed incoming transfer interior versus steady occurrence interior
repeated Layout definition and equal split position sharing one projection; distinct split positions not sharing
2D draw guides versus 3D draw with no guides; solo on/off; Zone off stage in the active Layout
Fast and Precise fidelity; desktop 1440 and narrow 390 with keyboard traversal
sequences: build windows -> query before/at/after a switch, at Show End and into the second loop -> mask a synthetic frame through the resolved window
mount prepared bundle -> read paint -> solo a Zone -> seek past the Layout switch -> read paint -> show all Zones
narrow a later Layout -> seek past the switch -> read paint and the unstaged-pixel note
enable Zone outlines -> read rect geometry -> seek past the switch -> read rect geometry -> disable

hydrate native bytes on the real route -> reset transport to zero -> read guides -> solo -> play across the switch -> read guides -> pause -> capture two Fast and two Precise frames before and after the switch -> reopen artifacts -> narrow 390 keyboard traversal
oracles: Presented pixels: the packed frame the real renderer receives, compared against an independently created replay runtime's frame masked by an independently built plan for the expected Layout.
Dev preview-publication digests read from the running page: unchanged across presentation toggles, single digest across the whole flow.
Zone guide rectangle geometry in the live DOM before and after a real playback Layout switch.
Provider writes counted on the route: zero for every presentation action; artifacts still reopen through their importers.
